subject: boolean-spelling
finding: Old chapter advertised and/or as executable aliases
resolution: Use &&/||/! and exact Unicode aliases; English words reject

subject: runtime-vs-compile
finding: Old limits/type text conflated runtime traps with compile diagnostics
resolution: Separate check/emit/build rejection from accepted-program runtime error and atomic sink behavior

subject: generic-trace
finding: All old rules pointed to one campaign label
resolution: Each rule expands to concrete case IDs and verified observations

subject: for-header
finding: Earlier EBNF admitted arbitrary expressions after in
resolution: Current header requires a bound iterable; add index/filter alternatives from the native owner

subject: list-argument
finding: Earlier structural grammar omitted untyped list arguments to typed constructors
resolution: Represent contextual bracketed argument lists without declaring untyped list values

subject: nullary-match
finding: Earlier match grammar required a payload identifier inside parentheses
resolution: Allow None() without a payload binding and retain finite type/coverage checks

subject: ordinary-import
finding: Earlier ordinary program grammar omitted required stdlib imports
resolution: Include native import declarations before ordinary declarations/entry

subject: doc-expectation
finding: Arbitrary doc labels did not define the bounded test-docs exit oracle
resolution: Record and exercise the native exit-N label contract

subject: historical-proposals
finding: Historical prose and internal symbols could be mistaken for active source APIs
resolution: Preserve exact stable/maturity classifications and distinct identity kinds

subject: stale-composition-imports
finding: Five semantic regression sources lacked now-mandatory std.fs imports
resolution: Add explicit imports while retaining the same runtime failure and atomicity oracles

subject: diagnostic-option-routing
finding: Public wrapper rejected native diagnostic recovery and path options, also breaking LSP publication
resolution: Forward bounded check options to their native owner; preserve duplicate and combination rejection

subject: module-initialization-boundary
finding: Native dependency initialization ordering could imply admitted effectful imported startup
resolution: Separate native topology/rollback guarantees from the public pure profile with zero runtime user initializers
